page.layout: One page: a leather book cover (dark red binding with gold tooled border and a central gold oval crest of a shield with a serpent, within a laurel wreath). No printed text on the cover itself. A small digitiser's watermark in the lower right corner.
page.notes: Binding cover, not a printed text page. The gold oval crest shows a shield with a serpent (staff of Aesculapius) within a laurel wreath and a crown above; it is an ornament, not text. The faint "Google" watermark in the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
